rules.title: Browser caches
rules.description: Chrome / Firefox caches — pages reload a bit slower once

rules.title: Developer caches
rules.description: Package-manager and tool caches — rebuilt when next used

rules.title: Package manager caches
rules.description: Downloaded .deb / package files kept after installing. They are owned by root, so the package manager should clear them rather than the Trash.
rules.adviceCommand: sudo apt-get clean   ·   sudo paccache -r   ·   sudo dnf clean all

rules.title: systemd journal logs
rules.description: The system log. It is capped by configuration rather than deleted by hand — vacuuming it is the supported way, and keeps journalctl working.

rules.title: Flatpak and Snap runtimes
rules.description: Old runtime versions and retained Snap revisions. Removing the directory by hand breaks the apps that share those runtimes — the package tools free the same space safely.
rules.adviceCommand: flatpak uninstall --unused   ·   sudo snap set system refresh.retain=2
